content_units: Kitchen Sink Leak: What’s Most Likely Going On

Because the leak happens   only when the dishwasher drains  , the problem is most likely in the   waste/drain side  , not the clean water supply. The repeated pattern over two months suggests a   partial blockage, bad connection, or poor drain setup   rather than a one-off spill.
Most likely causes, in order:
-   Loose or failing dishwasher drain hose connection   at the sink trap or waste spigot
-   Cracked trap, waste arm, or compression fitting   under the sink
-   Partial blockage in the trap or branch waste line  , causing backflow when the dishwasher pumps out
-   Dishwasher standpipe/high-loop/air-gap setup issue  , letting discharge water push out at a joint
-   Worn sink waste seals or basket strainer seals   that only leak under heavy discharge volume
-   Cabinet damage from repeated wetting  , which may need minor carpentry drying/repair after the plumbing fix
Leak Diagnosis and Quote Comparison Table
Use this to understand what you may be paying for and to compare plumbers fairly.
Likely issue   Usual fix   Typical visit complexity   Likely cost range   Fit for ZAR 4,500 budget   What to ask in the quote
Loose dishwasher hose or clamp   Refit hose; replace clamp/seal   Low     ZAR 700–1,500     Very likely   Does price include new clamp/hose tail and leak test during drain cycle?
Faulty sink trap or compression joint   Replace P-trap/trap fittings   Low-Medium     ZAR 1,000–2,200     Very likely   Are parts included; PVC or branded trap; warranty on fittings?
Partial blockage in trap/branch waste   Clear blockage; flush line   Medium     ZAR 900–2,500     Likely   Is drain clearing included or charged separately from call-out?
Incorrect dishwasher drain configuration   Re-route hose; add high loop/secure line   Medium     ZAR 1,200–2,800     Likely   Will they correct hose routing and secure it to prevent repeat leaks?
Hidden crack or damaged waste assembly   Replace multiple drain components   Medium-High     ZAR 2,000–4,500     Possible but near ceiling   What exact components are being replaced and why?

Moisture damage beyond plumbing fix   Plumbing plus minor cabinet mitigation   High     ZAR 3,000–5,500+     Plumbing yes; cabinet work may exceed   Is cabinet repair excluded, and do they recommend drying first?
What to Collect Before You Call
Have this ready so plumbers can quote more accurately and avoid vague call-out pricing:
-   Short video of the leak during dishwasher drain
- Best evidence: start recording when the dishwasher begins pumping out
- Capture exactly   where water appears first
-   Photos of the full under-sink area
- Trap, waste pipe, dishwasher hose connection, valves, cabinet base
-   Timing details
- “Leak appears only during dishwasher drain, not when tap runs normally”
- “Occurred 3 times in 2 months”
-   Amount of water
- A few drops, puddle, or enough to wet the cabinet floor?
-   Cabinet condition
- Note the   mild swelling   and whether chipboard/MDF is soft to touch
-   Appliance and sink details
- Dishwasher brand/model if visible
- Single or double sink
- Any recent plumbing/appliance installation or movement
-   Access constraints
- 2-bedroom flat in Cape Town
-   Weekdays after 16:00 only
-   Your budget
- Mention   cap of ZAR 4,500   and ask what can realistically be done within it
Useful wording for the call:
- “Please quote for diagnosis and repair of a leak under the kitchen sink that happens only when the dishwasher drains.”
- “I need availability on weekdays after 16:00.”
- “Please separate call-out, labour, parts, and any drain-clearing charges.”
How to Compare Plumber Quotes Fairly
Get   3 quotes   and compare them on the same scope, not just the headline price.
Check each quote for:
-   Call-out fee
- Is it waived if you approve the repair?
-   After-hours pricing
- After 16:00 may still be standard for some plumbers, but others may treat later visits as premium
-   Labour basis
- Fixed-price repair vs hourly rate
-   Parts included
- Trap, clamps, seals, hose, fittings
-   Drain-clearing included or extra
- This is a common hidden add-on for your symptom pattern
-   Leak testing included
- They should run the dishwasher drain or simulate discharge before leaving
-   Warranty
- Ask for   30–90 days   minimum on workmanship if possible
-   Exclusions
- Cabinet repair, mold treatment, wall opening, appliance repair
Best comparison method:
- Compare quotes using one standard request:
-   Diagnosis
-   Repair of drain-side leak under sink
-   Dishwasher drain test after repair
-   Written breakdown: call-out + labour + parts
- Prefer:
- A plumber who clearly explains the likely fault
- A written quote with line items
- A commitment to test during an actual dishwasher drain cycle
- Be cautious if:
- They quote a large replacement job without asking for photos/video
- They refuse to break down charges
- They won’t confirm weekday after-16:00 availability
Best Budget Strategy for Your Situation
With   ZAR 4,500  , you should usually be able to cover:
- Diagnosis
- Standard under-sink drain repair
- Trap/fitting replacement
- Minor drain clearing
- Leak testing
Your budget may be tight only if:
- The waste line inside the wall is blocked/damaged
- There’s extensive cabinet damage
- The dishwasher itself is draining improperly and needs appliance service too
Practical decision guide:
-   Best-case  : hose/clamp/trap issue → likely well under budget
-   Most probable  : trap/connection/partial blockage → usually still within budget
-   Higher-risk  : hidden pipe damage or cabinet restoration → may exceed budget if both are needed
